verdict.rationale: Dynamics 365 Sales exposes the Dataverse Web API, which supports querying related record collections, SQL SELECT, and FetchXML with joins. An external agent could use this to pull an account's deals and history. Separately, built-in Copilot produces meeting preparation notes covering customer status and past meeting notes, but nothing shows that brief can be reached via the API or an MCP server. missing for 10: an official MCP server, documented API retrieval of open opportunities and recent emails/activities for an account brief, an agent-callable brief endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: You can query any collection of entities that a collection-valued navigation property represents for a specified record.
Compose XML-based queries to retrieve data from Dataverse, including filtering, joining, and paging results.
Retrieve data by passing SQL `SELECT` commands through the Web API `sql` query option.
View AI-generated opportunity summaries and meeting preparation notes including customer status, relevant news, and past meeting notes.
